name: draw_svg
description: Draw a picture on the page with the pen. Give a complete SVG for a 768x1024 page. The device is black-and-white e-ink and the pen draws lines, so use simple line art: fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3" on every shape, no gradients, no transparency, no shadows, no style tags. Text inside the drawing must use font-family="Noto Sans", fill="black", font-size 28 or larger. Drawing takes time, so keep it to a few dozen shapes. Include xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" on the svg tag.

description.description: One line saying what the drawing shows.

svg.description: The SVG document, 768 wide by 1024 tall, black line art only.
